Who you are booking with

A small Agra outfit that has been doing this a long time

We started in 2000 with one car and a guide licence. The work has not changed much since: meet people at their hotel, show them the Taj Mahal properly, and get them where they are going next without a fuss.

What that means in practice is boring in the best way. The driver knows which gate to use on a Friday. The guide knows when to stop talking. The quotation you get is the amount you pay.

Why choose Tajview Holidays

An Agra-based team since 2000. Here is what that means for your trip — and what you can hold us to.

Local experts, not a call centre

We live in Agra and have run tours across North India since 2000. The person who plans your trip knows the roads, the monuments and the hotels first-hand.

100% private, on your clock

Your own air-conditioned car, your own chauffeur and your own guide. No coaches, no strangers, no fixed group timings — leave when you are ready.

Licensed guides in every city

Government-approved, English-speaking guides who bring the history to life and know when to let you simply look.

Hotels we have stayed in

Every hotel on your itinerary has been checked by our team — clean, safe, well located and honest about its star rating.

Clear prices, no surprises

One written quotation listing everything included and everything not. No hidden charges and no commission stops at shops you did not ask for.

24/7 support on WhatsApp

One number answered before, during and after your trip — a delayed flight at 3 am or a change of plan at lunch, someone always picks up.

Agra tour packages from a local Agra tour operator

Tajview Holidays is a travel agency based in Agra, the home of the Taj Mahal. We have planned private tours of Agra, Delhi, Jaipur and Rajasthan since 2000.

Same day Agra tour by car

Our most booked trip: a same day Agra tour by car from Delhi with pickup from your hotel or the airport, the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort with a licensed guide, lunch, and back in Delhi the same evening. Prefer the train? Take the Taj Mahal tour by Gatimaan Express, Delhi to Agra in about 100 minutes.

Taj Mahal sunrise and overnight tours

The Taj Mahal is at its best in the first hour of light. Our Taj Mahal sunrise tour leaves Delhi at 3 am; the 2 days Taj Mahal overnight tour adds sunset at Mehtab Bagh and an unhurried morning. See every Taj Mahal tour package.

Agra local sightseeing

Already in Agra? Our Agra local sightseeing tour by car covers the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Itimad-ud-Daulah and Mehtab Bagh with a government-approved guide. Add Fatehpur Sikri or a Mathura Vrindavan day trip.

Golden Triangle, Rajasthan and wildlife

Agra sits at the heart of the Golden Triangle tour with Delhi and Jaipur. From here we run Rajasthan tour packages, Ranthambore and Corbett wildlife safaris, and car rental with driver in Agra.

Before you book

The questions that come up most often, answered the way we would answer them on the phone.

Are your tours really private?
Yes, every one. The car carries your party and nobody else, and the departure time is whatever you choose. We do not run shared coaches at all.
Do I pay a deposit to get an itinerary?
No. You get a written day-by-day plan with named hotels and a fixed price before any money changes hands. If it is not right, we rework it.
Will the driver stop at shops for commission?
No. That practice is why most people distrust Indian tour operators, and we do not take a cut from any shop. If you want to shop, say so and we take you somewhere good.
What is the best time of year to visit?
October to March is the comfortable season. December and January bring morning fog around Delhi and Agra. April to June is hot, which makes sunrise starts essential rather than optional.
Is the Taj Mahal closed on any day?
Yes, every Friday. We plan itineraries around it, and if your dates are fixed we will tell you before you book rather than after.
Can you handle dietary needs and mobility limits?
Usually, with notice. Tell us at the enquiry stage — most things can be arranged in advance and very few can be fixed on the day.
How much does a same day Agra tour from Delhi cost?
Our private same day Agra tour by car starts from ₹7,900 per person, including the car, driver, a licensed guide, tolls and parking. The Gatimaan Express train tour starts from ₹11,500. Every quote is fixed before you pay.
Do you offer Agra local sightseeing if we are already in Agra?
Yes. Our Agra local sightseeing tour picks you up from any Agra hotel or railway station and covers the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, the Baby Taj and sunset at Mehtab Bagh with a licensed guide.
What happens if a flight is delayed?
Tell us and we reshape the day. The driver and guide are ours, not a subcontracted agency, so changing the plan is a phone call rather than a renegotiation.
